targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "4SD")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "4SD")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "BTN")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "presses")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "GSG")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0 }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DUS2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DPIR2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.simulated =~ /${simulated:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then "MOTION" else "CLEAR" }))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "DS2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.pi_id == "${pi_id}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: string(v: r._value) }))
